scientific_question: On the same eight native target-binder complexes, does strict native recovery depend primarily on evolutionary-input representation, predictor identity, or a predictor-by-representation interaction?

target_msa_binder_query.boltz_encoding: Target sequence uses the frozen target A3M; binder sequence uses msa: empty.
target_msa_binder_query.af2_encoding: Annotated multimer A3M contains the paired native query, unpaired frozen target rows, and one unpaired binder query row; it makes no coevolutionary pairing claim.

query_only_both_chains.boltz_encoding: Both native sequences use msa: empty.
query_only_both_chains.af2_encoding: Annotated multimer A3M contains only the paired native target-binder query and no homolog rows.

representation_contract.chain_order: Predictor chain A is the frozen target and predictor chain B is the native binder.

baseline_reuse.rationale: The complete W3c-B2 Boltz cell already used the frozen target set, runtime identity, seed, template boundary, network boundary, and target-MSA-plus-binder-query information contract. Reusing all eight outcomes avoids redundant compute and prevents selective rescue.

primary_endpoint.success_rule: strict_qc_passed and finite interface_pae and finite ligand_rmsd_angstrom < 4.0

decision_contract.native_validity_recovered_rule: At least one representation must qualify at 6/8 or better for both predictors under that same representation.
decision_contract.representation_specific_rule: The same representation must strongly dominate the other representation within both predictors.
decision_contract.predictor_specific_rule: The same predictor must strongly dominate the other predictor within both representations.
decision_contract.interaction_rule: Strong directional winners reverse across the matched representation or predictor comparisons.
decision_contract.partial_localization_rule: At least one strong directional contrast exists but it is not replicated across the orthogonal factor.
decision_contract.unresolved_rule: No frozen localization rule is met.

stop_rules: Do not rerun or recover any W3c-B2 job.
Stop if any source hash, target, runtime identity, representation encoding, seed, template boundary, or network boundary differs from this protocol.
Stop unless all 24 prospective records pass strict provenance and QC; do not adjudicate a partial panel.
Keep candidate generation blocked unless both predictors qualify under the same representation.
Even after native validity is recovered, require a separate generator protocol and explicit compute approval.

claim_boundary.maximum_current_claim: A post-W3c-B2 representation-by-predictor diagnostic has been preregistered with an immutable eight-record baseline and 24 prospective cells; no new prediction has been run.

next_action: Build and validate the W3d CPU-only input producer and corrected no-prediction runtime wrappers for the 24 prospective cells, then stop before any compute approval packet.
